Photonic Computing and Fault Simulation

自主研發 · 互動技術展示

透過雙模干涉單元，觀察相位偏移與振幅衰減如何改變兩個輸出埠。

討論光子模擬與科學運算 操作光子故障模擬

產業問題與工程挑戰

光子運算架構對相位誤差與插入損耗敏感，設計初期需要釐清元件變動對輸出的影響。 軟體模型需要明示損耗、幅度與功率的定義，才有辦法與未來元件量測對照。

技術方法與架構

實作與交付

瀏覽器用解析式計算理想化的 Mach–Zehnder 干涉單元。互動參數代表單一路徑的偏差，輸出可立即重現。

成果

相位與衰減控制會更新兩個輸出埠功率及合計，供檢查模型行為。

  • 單一干涉單元的互動式模擬
  • 元件假設與驗證方式

驗證與證據

理想、無損單元的兩埠功率和等於輸入功率。相位改變輸出分配，引入衰減會改變總輸出。結果適用於標示的理想化模型。

Technical Note

Photonic Computing and Fault Simulation

Independent Research and Development · Interactive Demonstration

Use a two-mode interferometer to inspect how phase error and amplitude loss change its two output ports.

繁體中文 Run the photonic fault simulation

Industry problem and engineering challenge

Photonic systems are sensitive to phase errors and insertion loss. Early design work needs a way to examine how changes in components affect the output. A software model should specify how it defines loss, amplitude and power so that future device measurements can be compared with its predictions.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

The browser evaluates an analytical Mach–Zehnder model. The controls represent a deviation on one path, so the output can be reproduced immediately.

Outcome

Phase and attenuation controls update the power at both ports and the total, allowing direct inspection of the model.

  • Interactive simulation of one interferometer
  • Component assumptions and validation checks

Validation and evidence

The two port powers in the ideal lossless model sum to the input power. Phase redistributes energy. Attenuation changes the total output. Results apply to the stated idealized model.
